_why: Written 2026-08-08. Mythwright is the fleet's most server-bound product — every mode including solo Practice is a per-turn round trip, and accounts are real (Sign in with Apple/Google, email claim linked). Only ONE absolute claim survives that, and it is approved below. The refuted entries record the three claims that were removed from this site on 2026-08-08 so they cannot drift back.

evidence: No advertising SDK is linked: a grep across Mythwright *.swift and *.pbxproj for GoogleMobileAds, AdMob and AppLovin returns nothing. The single 'advertis' hit is the English word in a ShopView.swift:210 comment about coming-soon items.

SCOPE: support.html pairs it with the sharing claim — 'does not share personal information with advertisers, and the app contains no advertising or third-party tracking'. That is about ADVERTISERS and ad/tracking SDKs, and is true; it is not a claim that nothing leaves the device, which for Mythwright would be false.

offline.why: Mythwright has no offline mode at all. Every mode including solo Practice is a server round trip per turn (MythwrightAPI.swift:630,655 POST /practice/...), there is no NWPathMonitor anywhere in the app, and Practice is itself sign-in gated (PlayView.swift:960).

anonymous_identifier.why: Accounts are Sign in with Apple/Google. The backend receives the identity token with the email claim inside, MeResponse returns email, and PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares Email Address and User ID as LINKED. There is no anonymous identifier to claim.

icloud_sync.why: The entitlements file has no iCloud or CloudKit capability. Sync is PUT /me/decks against mythwright-api. The phrase 'where enabled, iCloud sync' described a feature that does not exist.

contract_notes: The Card Forge TEXT vendor is deliberately unnamed on this site. It is not determinable from the machines we have: README contradicts itself (Sonnet at :41 vs gpt-4o at :67), ForgeView comments contradict themselves (:457 vs :635), and mythwright-api source is absent. The generic 'third-party model provider' wording is the only claim we can stand behind; naming a vendor requires the backend repo or a live probe of /forge/. The IMAGE side is gpt-image-1. See SITE-CONTRADICTIONS-RESOLVED-2026-08-08.md section 1.
